# Decision

Epic26D3PortableProfile records the approved additive profile: repository-local Markdown, YAML, and Git remain canonical; the shared offline parser, schema, linter, viewer, and query helper may add typed semantics. JSON-LD, RDF, SHACL, remote services, and mandatory semantic-web infrastructure remain deferred.

# Consequences

New strict records can use stable IDs, typed relationships, assertion state, and immutable evidence. Legacy records remain visible in warning mode. Any curation, cadence, archive, canary, or rollout still requires its own bounded operator authority.
